text:
leo_sales: Partner CISO asked for a clear one-pager on our incident response commitments, who drives external notices, and how that ties to SIG/CAIQ. Need a short blurb I can send.

ashley_security: TL;DR we issue an initial factual acknowledgement after we confirm an incident (we aim to provide that within 72 hours of confirmation). Follow-ups are sent as new facts are validated. For hosted customers Redwood takes responsibility for customer-facing notifications per contract; for VPC/on-prem we supply evidence and support but the customer typically issues external notices.

leo_sales: Can you drop 3 bullets I can paste? Buyer wants plain language, not legalese.

ashley_security: Quick pasteable bullets:
- Acknowledgement: Redwood provides an initial factual acknowledgement within 72 hours of incident confirmation and posts follow-up updates as new information is verified.
- Hosted vs VPC: Hosted (Redwood issues external notices where contractually required). VPC/on-prem (customer leads external disclosure; Redwood supplies technical findings/evidence).
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: We can provide a SIG extract that highlights our IR controls and tabletop cadence; available under request with appropriate sharing controls.

jordan_ps: Buyer also wants an escalation list and a tiny example notice. Can we give both? Keep it short.

ashley_security: Escalation snippet for SOW/SLA:
- Redwood SOC (primary): security@redwood.com (24/7 monitoring)
- Legal review: legal@redwood.com (escalate during business hours)
- Account & AM: assigned AM email (for Dedicated/Private customers we include AM in all incident comms)
- Evidence delivery (VPC): coordinate with customer's SOC for secure artifact transfer (S3 signed URL / secure SCP)

ashley_security: Short example notice (customer-facing):

```
Subject: Security Notice: [Service] incident affecting [customer name]

We are writing to inform you we have confirmed an incident that affected [service/component]. At this time, confirmed impact is limited to [confirmed scope].

What we did: detected, contained, and initiated forensic collection; initial mitigation applied.
Next steps: additional analysis is underway; we will provide an update by [ETA/date]. Contact: security@redwood.com.
```

ravi_sec: Add: we only publish confirmed scope. If investigations are ongoing we say "under investigation" and avoid speculative details. Also note retention: IR artifacts and timelines are kept for 12 months unless longer retention is required contractually.

matt_legal: Legal clarifications to include with any customer text: 1) "72 hours" references time from confirmed incident discovery, not initial alert; 2) language should avoid admissions of fault; 3) copy legal@redwood.com on outgoing notices and route any NDA requests through legal.

leo_sales: Pricing question: customer asked if we can do a tabletop / runbook review during POC. What's standard?

jordan_ps: Standard add-on offering: 1 tabletop facilitation + 90-minute runbook workshop + executive summary. Typical price band: $15k$40k depending on scope. We usually spin this as a PS line item in the SOW for POCs.

ashley_security: Also offer a lightweight SIG extract for IR controls at no charge for evaluation; full SIG/CAIQ package behind a controlled share (NDA) if they require.

ir_bot: Incident packet template created: IR-PKT-2026-1105 (internal ref).

leo_sales: Perfect, sending this now. If they request the full SIG I'll get legal to handle the external share. Thanks all :pray:
